Body.Content: Azure Websites now supports Python 3.4, along with automatic configuration in the Azure Portal. Python is off by default, but when a specific Python version is selected a handler mapping is automatically generated and applied. Custom handler mappings (described in Azure Websites Python configuration documentation) are still supported.
